275229744.description: This lot includes a variety of collectible gemstones and minerals featuring both rough and polished specimens. Included is a large blue agate slice edged with gold, multiple mineral display pieces, and a boxed 'Natural Wonders Gemstone Collection: Jewels in the Rough' set with labeled samples such as turquoise, citrine, agate, tiger eye, amazonite, fluorite, peridot, and others. Additional loose stones are present in various colors including red, green, blue, pink, and clear, in assorted shapes. The lot also contains a polished stone sphere and a tall polished mineral obelisk. Items are in good used condition, suitable for collectors, educational use, or decorative purposes.
